arguments.heading: What happened at the argument
paragraphs: Ms. Metcalf argued federal courts should not review everyday employer decisions.
Mr. Katyal stated the Ninth Circuit required a suspect class for claims.
Ms. Blatt argued class-of-one claims fail in public employment contexts.
Justice Roberts asked if minor time-sheet errors justify a termination decision.

sections.heading: What this case is about
paragraphs: This case tests the limits of the Equal Protection Clause. It asks if a single public employee can sue for damages when a boss acts out of personal dislike. The state argues this power belongs to the employer, not the courts.
